newsitem.title: CANADA: Edper to buy lands from CIBC unit.
newsitem.headline: Edper to buy lands from CIBC unit.

text.p: The Edper Group Ltd said on Tuesday it agreed to acquire the Bay Wellington Tower lands in Toronto which form part of BCE Place from CIBC Development Corp, a unit of the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce.
The purchase will be completed through a wholly owned unit of Edper issuing a C$104 million six percent preferred share which will be retractable in 10 years.

The share can be redeemed for cash or for a number of class A Edper shares based on the market price of Edper at that time or for eight million common shares of Brookfield Properties Corp owned by Edper.
Edper has agreed to grant Brookfield a first right of purchase of the lands at Edper's carried cost.

"The acquisition of these lands is of strategic importance to Brookfield as it will enable Brookfield to unify the land and the leasehold interest in Bay Wellington Tower at a future time," Edper President and Chief Executive Robert Harding said in a statement.

"As a freehold property, this will allow Brookfield to generate substantial savings on financing costs, broaden its financing alternatives for the property, and result in the creation of substantial net asset value through the lowering of market capitalization applied to this property," he added.
